hints.title: Grid State Representation
hints.text: Mark cells with guards and walls so they can be distinguished from empty spaces during simulation.

hints.title: Directional Ray Marching
hints.text: From each guard, cast rays in four cardinal directions (up, down, left, right), marking visited open cells as guarded until encountering a wall or another guard.

hints.title: Preventing Redundant Traversals
hints.text: Marking cells as guarded prevents stopping prematurely. Rays pass through already guarded cells but stop at obstacles.

hints.title: Matrix Simulation Implementation

complexity.notes: Each cell is traversed a constant number of times across all directions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating full grid scans without obstacle caching causes redundant work.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grid array of dimensions m x n stores obstacle and guarded states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate distinguishes walls/guards from guarded empty cells and terminates ray extensions appropriately.
